tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dril bu lha lnga'i dbang chog dbang bskur snying po gsal byed ces bya ba bzhugs so//

༄༅// "$ bla ma dang bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ni/ sa chog dang sta gon sogs sngon du 'gro ba'i rim pa gzhan du shes par bya la/ 'dir dus rgyun du nyams su blang ba'i rim pa ni/ sngon 'gro gtor ma btang*/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa'i bar byas nas mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor khaṇ+ḍa ro he sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa dang shū n+ya tās sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las chos 'byung gi rang bzhin/ de'i dbus su yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu'i dbyibs can rgyal mtshan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pa chus gang bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po zur bzhir rdo rje rtse gsum pas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du suṃ las ri rab rin po che sna bzhi'i rang bzhin can rtse mo lcog brgyad kyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ de'i steng du hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje rtse mo bcu gnyis pa phyogs kyi mdog can de'i lte bar bh+rūṃ las 'khor lo dkar po yongs su gyur pa las/ gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi dang bcas pa/ rtsig pa phyi nas rim pa bzhin dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba/ steng 'og gi kha dog kyang g.yon skor gyis de dang 'dra ba/ rtsig pa'i steng du rin po che'i snam bu dmar po khra sna tshogs kyis mdzes pa/ de'i steng du chu srin gyi kha nas 'phyang ba'i do shal dang do shal phyed pa/ de'i steng du bya 'dab las 'phyang ba'i ba ku lī dkar po/ de'i steng du kra ma shīr+ṣa pad+ma 'dab ma phyed pa'i dbyibs can/ de dag gi bar bar du bum pa la gnas pa'i rgyal mtshan dang ba dan rlung gis bskyod pa'i dril bu g.yer kha'i sgra dang ldan pa/

phyi nas 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar pos bskor ba'i steng na/ gzungs ma rnams kyis mchod rdzas sna tshogs thogs pa/ sgo dang sgo khyud kyi mtshams su zla phyed rdo rje rin po ches spras shing*/ rin po che'i ka ba phyogs mdog can brgyad kyis bteg pa'i steng du rdo rje'i gdung zlum gyis phub pa/ rtse mo rdo rje rin po che'i tog can// phyi rol tu rnam shes brgyad dag pa'i dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor ba'i gzhal yas khang de'i nang du paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa mu khyud la gri gug gi 'phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūṃ sngon po dang paṃ dmar po las/ zhes pa nas/ bzhugs par gyur gyi bar bdag bskyed bzhin dang*/ shar gyi 'dab ma mkha' 'gro ma sdon mo/ byang du lā ma ljang khu/ nub tu dum skyes ma dmar mo// lhor gzugs can ma ser mo/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig spyan gsum ma/ mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa/ gcer mo skra grol ba/ thod skam lngas dbu brgyan pa/ dum bu lnga bcu'i do shal dang ldan pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas gri gug dang ḍā ma ru/ g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba dang kha ṭāṃ ga bsnams pa/ thams cad ro dang zla ba la g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa'o// mtshams kyi zla gdan la bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba'i steng du ka pā la byang chub kyi sems kyis gang ba bzhis kha brgyan pa'o// sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa/ go bgo ba/ ye shes pa dgug gzhug bya ba/ dbang bskur rgyas gdab pa rnams bdag bskyed ltar ro// phyogs ma bzhi la/ mkha' 'gro ma la rnam snang*/ lā ma la don grub/ dum skyes ma la 'od dpag med/ gzugs can ma la rin 'byung gis dbu brgyan par bsam mo// gtso bo yab yum dang mkha' 'gro ma bzhi'i sngags kyi mjug tu/ ar+ghaṃ sogs btags pa'i chu gnyis dang*/ nyer spyod lnga/

rin chen sna bdun/ 'dod yon lnga/ rig ma bcu drug khyad par bdud rtsi'i mchod pa dang de kho na nyid kyis mchod la/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che// zhes sogs kyis bstod/ bzlas pa cung zhig bya/ gtor ma 'bul ba'o// de nas bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa sa dkar gyis byugs/ ras zung gis mgul pa bcings/ 'bras bu can gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa'i nang du/ oṃ tap+te tap+te ma hā tap+te swā hā/ zhes pas lha'i dal 'gro'i chu bkug par bsams nas/ rdo rje la brten pa'i chus sum gnyis tsam dgang*/ sman lnga/ 'bru lnga/ dri lnga/ rin po che lnga/ snying po lnga rnams bcug rnam rgyal gyi steng du dung chos kyi chu la/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta u da ka ṭhaḥhūṃ bzlas shing*/ de'i steng du rdo rje la me tog gi 'phreng ba btags la bzhag rnam rgyal dang rnam rgyal chen po'i dung chos gnyis bh+rūṃ las gzhal yas khang gdan bcas su bskyed/ der lha dam tshig pa lnga bum pa dang bcas pa mdun bskyed bzhin bskyed/ las bum du pad nyi'i steng du paṃ las dum skyes ma bskyed nas/ dbang bskur ba yan chad mdun bskyed bzhin byas la/ mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba byas/ me tog gi lcug ma nas gzung la/ so so'i sngags brgya rtsa re bzlas/ slar yang me tog bcug spos kyis bdug gsol ba btab/ dung chos kyi chu blug pa'i rkyen gyis/ lha rnams chags pa chen po'i mes bzhu/ byang chub sems kyi chur gyur par bsams te/ bum pa bsgrub pa'o/// / de nas slob ma las thams cad pa bzlas pa'i chus khrus la/ me tog thogs te maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// rdo rje 'chang chen ngo bo nyid// dmigs med bde chen ston pa po// slob dpon chen po phyag 'tshal lo// don dam smra ba'i seng ge rnal 'byor nas/ grub par mdzod/ ces lan gsum gsol pa gdab/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro he hūm̐ hūṃ phaṭ/ ces brjod pas bsangs/

stong pa'i ngang las/ slob ma dpal 'khor lo bde mchog zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs khar bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs par bskyed nas/ las thams cad pa bzlas pa'i mig dar dmar po// oṃ tsak+ṣurban+dha ba ra mā na ya hūṃ/ zhes pas mig dar bcings/ aḥkhaṃ bī ra hūṃ gis me tog gi 'phreng ba lag tu bzung la/ las thams cad pa'i chus bsangs te/ kye dga' ba la dga' khyod su zhig des/ bde chen bdag ni bskal bzang lags// zhes dris lan gyis rigs nges par bya/ slob ma'i snying gar zla ba'i steng du rdo rje rtse lnga bsgoms te/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+gā da yā mi/ zhes brjod/ me tog dang bcas pas slob ma'i snying gar reg nas/ oṃ su ra te sa ma ya s+t+waṃ hoḥsid+dha badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes brjod cing don bshad cing bsgom/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di/ dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams la smra bar mi bya zhing*// ma dad par yang ma yin no// zhes gsang bar gdams/ las thams cad pa dang aḥkhaṃ wī ra hūṃ gis yol ba'i nang du gzhug sdom pa bsgrag gzung rnams sta gon ma song na skabs 'di nyid du bya'o// mgo bor rdo rje bzhag nas/ deng khyod dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis rigs su zhugs kyis/ ngas khyod la ye shes gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob na/ dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos te/ de lta bu'i ye shes bskyed par bya yis/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du brjod par mi bya ste/ dam tshig nyams par gyur ta re/ zhes mthong ba'i phan yon dang*/ mgo bor rdo rje bzhag dril bu dkrol zhing*/ 'di ni khyod kyi dam tshig rdo rje yin te/ tshul 'di 'ga' zhig la smras na mgo bo 'gas par byed do//

zhes ma gsang pa'i nyes dmigs dang snying gar rdo rje bzhag nas/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi// snying la yang dag zhugs par mdzad/ gal te tshul 'di smras na ni// de ma thag tu bral te gshegs// zhes ye shes babs pa gsang ma gsang gi phan yon dang nyes dmigs/ pad+ma'i nang gi bdud rtsi lnga la oṃ āḥhūṃ gis byin gyis brlabs nas/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// zhes pa nas/ oṃ badz+ra u da ka ṭhaḥṭhaḥ zhes pas 'thung du gzhug dam tshig bsrungs ma bsrungs kyi phan yon nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas dang*/ deng nas brtsams te khyod kyi dpal he ru ka nga yin gyis/ zhes sogs kyis bla ma bka' gnyan pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag par bya'o// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs la/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la dbab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba lan gsum gdab/ slob ma skad cig gis he ru kar gyur pa'i spyi bor baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor bum pas mtshan pa la yi ge ha/ snying gar laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor la hūṃ/ lte bar raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor la a/ rkang pa'i 'og tu yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor la yi ge dzhaiḥ drag cing bzod par dka' ba bsam/ de ka'i ngang las bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ rlung gis ba dan bsgul/ rlung g.yos/ me sbar/ dzhaiḥrkang mthil nas sum mdo'i me dang 'dres/ snying ga sa'i dkyil 'khor bsregs/ de'i drod kyis dpral ba'i chu khol// snying gar me chu 'thab pa'i drod kyis nyams dpag tu med pa skyes/ gzhan yang thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs spyan drangs te/ las kyi rdo rjes gu gul gyis bdug cing*/ ḍā ma ru dang dril bu dkrol zhing*/ snying po nye snying gi rjes su/ ā be sha ya to ṣa ya/ ra ra ra ra/ tsā la ya tsā la ya hūṃ haḥ.aḥdzhaiḥ zhes brgya'i bar brjod de mgo bor rdo rje bzhag

tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ zhes pas brtan par bya'o// de nas shar sgor langs la/ oṃ na maḥte hūṃ/ na mā mi hūṃ/ na mo na maḥhūṃ swā hā// brjod pas lus ngag yid gsum gyi phyag sngon du 'gro bas thal mo snying kha'i g.yon du sbyar la/ oṃ sar+b+ba wī ra yo gi nī bh+yaḥpū dzo pas+thā na ya āt+mā nāṃ nir+yā ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga tā wī ra yo ge nī ḍā ki nī a dhi tiṣ+ṭha māṃ/ zhes phyag byas pas mkha' 'gro ma mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul gyis byung nas/ snying gar thim pas rang mkha' 'gro mar gyur par bsam/ de bzhin du gzhan lha mo gsum la'ang 'gre'o// byang sgor thal mo dpral bar sbyar te/ oṃ sar+b+ba wī ra yo gi nī bh+yaḥpū dza a bhi ṣe kā ya āt+mā nāṃ nir+yā ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta wī ra yo gi nī lā ma a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ/ nub sgor thal mo lkog mar sbyar te/ oṃ sarba wī ra yo gi nī bh+yaḥpū dza pra warta nā ya āt+mā nāṃ nir+yā ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta wī ra yo gi nī khaṇ+ḍa ro he da pra warta yan+tu māṃ/ lho nas thal mo spyi bor sbyar la/ oṃ sarba wī ra yo gi nī bh+yaḥpū dza kar+m+ma ṇe āt+mā nāṃ nir+yā ta yā mi/ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta wī ra yo gi nī rū pi nī karma kar+yan+tu māṃ/ zhes pas phyag byed du gzhug de nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyis gnas/ lha mo rnams kyi chos 'byung nyid// bde chen sna tshogs khang brtsegs ma// he ru ka dpal dkyil 'khor mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di nyid du// bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bgyi// lha yi rigs kyi rim pa dag/ ces pa nas/ dkyil 'khor 'di ni de bzhin shog/ ces gsol ba btab nas bar snang gi kha dog phrin las bzhi'i dngos grub 'di 'grub/ ces brjod do// de nas sngags kyi me tog gi 'phreng ba trāṃ gis byin gyis brlabs pa sbyin nas/ rdo rje shugs kyi 'jug pas zhugs te/ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ

zhes pas bltos med du dor/ me tog lhung ba'i rjes su 'brangs la lha ngo bstan no// me tog 'phreng ba mgo bor bzhag la/ oṃ pra ti gṛh+na s+t+waṃ i maṃ sa twa ma hā ba la/ 'phreng ba'i dbang sbyin no// de nas slob ma'i mig gnyis su nyi ma la hūṃ/ dpral bar raṃ bkod la/ oṃ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi// mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad// phye bas thams cad mthong 'gyur te// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med// oṃ dz+nyā na tsak+ṣu badz+ra hūṃ swā hā// zhes brjod pas mig dbye nas// dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos// zhes pa nas/ dam tshig thams cad bskyang ba dang*// sngags kyi dngos grub brtson par gyis// zhes brjod la rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor bstan cing*// de'i nang nas khyod kyis lha 'di la me tog phog pas// de yi rigs yin no// zhes pa ste dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i rim pa'o// de nas maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ ji ltar sangs rgyas mkhas rnams kyis// rdo rje sems dpa' dbang bskur ltar// bdag kyang mgon pos dbang bskur zhing*// mchog kyang bdag la stsal du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab la/ de nas slob dpon gyis rang dang slob ma dbang rdzas gsum ka mi dmigs pa bsgom dgos la/ slob mas rang lhar bsgom pas chog bla mas las thams cad pa bzlas pa'i chus/ slob bu dang bum chu bsangs sbyangs/ shū n+ya tā sa stong par bsgom/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma/ raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i thugs kyi 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog sngon po phyag g.yas rdo rje bsgyings pa dang bcas pas thugs khar gtod pa g.yon dril bu snyems pa dang bcas pas dkur 'dzin pa la rang 'dra'i shes rab mas 'khyud par bskyed/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ bstim/ yang dbang lha spyan drangs/ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab yum rnams kyis bum chu mi bskyod par bskyed pa la/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūṃ/ zhes dbang bskur/ rigs bdag gis dbu brgyan pa la mchod/ snyoms par zhugs pas byang sems kyi rang bzhin du zhu ba'i bum chur blta'o// de nas rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ gshegs pa gshegs ma/ sems dpa' sems ma// khro bo khro mo spyan drangs slob ma la dbang bskur pa'i don du/ rdo rje can gyis 'gro skyabs phyir// sangs rgyas rnams kyis dbang bskur ba// yon tan 'byung gnas ji ltar stsal// de bzhin 'di la'ang stsal du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pas dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad// yum bzhi phag mo dang lngas me tog dang gur kum sogs kyi char 'bebs bzhin pas bum pa'i chus khrus gsol/ sems dpas bkra shis brjod par bsam la/ slob dpon gyis brjod lha mo rnams kyis mchod par bsam la/ las kyi rdo rjes mchod/ de rnams dbang rdzas so so'i ting nge 'dzin ma gtogs 'og ma kun la 'gre'o// slob dpon gyis rdor dril dang rnam rgyal bum pa 'dzin pas/ bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi dbyings las nges 'byung ba// zhes sogs bkra shis kyi tshig brjod pa'i rjes su/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni//

zhes pa nas/ gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya/ oṃ pañtsa ḍā ki nī wī ra s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ zhes dang*/ lha gzhan rnams kyis brjod cing*/ mjug tu oṃ badz+ra u da ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ su ra te stāṃ a haṃ/ zhes brjod cing dbang bskur/ lus ye shes kyi chus gang*/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pas rigs bdag gis dbu rgyan/ dbang bskur mkhan gyi lha thams cad mi bskyod pa'i rnam pas slob bu'i lus la thim pa la mchod pas mchod/ chu'i dbang thob/ zhe sdang gi dri ma sbyangs/ rnam shes kyi phung po gnas gyur/ chos dbyings ye shes mngon du byas/ mi bskyod pa'i sa bon dang bag chags bzhag mi bskyod pa la brten pa'i dngos grub dang 'phrin las bsgrub pa la dbang po/ des dag pa sbyin no// de ltar slob bu dang dbu rgyan bsangs sbyangs/ trāṃ dang rin po che las skyes pa'i ye shes 'khor lo bde mchog g.yas rin po che bsgyings pa dang bcas pas dkur 'dzin/ g.yon dril bu thugs khar phyogs pa la/ rang 'dra'i shes rab mas 'khyud/ sngar bzhin zhu ba las byung ba'i dbu rgyan du gyur/ rin chen can gyis 'gro skyabs phyir/ zhes sogs dang*/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ zhes pa'i rjes la/ yon tan dpag med 'byung ba'i gnas/ yid bzhin rin chen sna tshogs rgyal// ngo mtshar gzi brjid chen po'i mchog /cod pan gyi ni dbang bskur ro// oṃ āḥbadz+ra mu ku ṭa a bhiṣiñtsa hūṃ/ su ra tastāṃ a haṃ/ zhes brjod cing chus kyang dbang bskur/ rigs bdag gis dbu brgyan/ dbang gi lha rnams rin 'byung gi rnam pas thim/ de la mchod/ dbu rgyan gyi dbang thob/ nga rgyal dang ser sna dag tshor ba'i phung po gnas gyur/ mnyam nyid ye shes mngon du byas/ rin 'byung gi sa bon dang bag chags bzhag de la brten pa'i dngos grub dang 'phrin las bsgrub pa la dbang ngo*// rdo rje dang slob ma bsangs sbyangs/

oṃ dang pad+ma yongs su gyur pa las/ gsung gi 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog dmar po/ g.yas pad+ma dmar po bsgyings pa dang*/ g.yon dril bu/ zhu ba las byung ba'i rdo rje/ pad+ma can gyis 'gro skyabs phyir// sogs dang*/ dbang bskur rdo rje sogs dang*/ sangs rgyas rdo rje'i dbang bskur bas// de ni khyod nyid dbang bskur bya// 'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad nyid// rdo rje 'grub phyir rdo rje long*// badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa/ zhes brjod/ snying mgrin dpral bar gtugs/ lag g.yas su sbyin/ chus kyang dbang bskur/ rigs bdag gis dbu brgyan/ 'od dpag med kyi rnam pa lus la thim pa la mchod/ 'od dpag med rdo rje'i dbang thob/ 'dod chags kyi dri ma dag 'du shes kyi phung po gnas gyur/ sor rtogs ye shes mngon du byas/ 'od dpag med kyi/ de la brten pa'i sogs brjod do// de nas slob ma dang dril bu bsangs sbyangs/ khaṃ dang sna tshogs rdo rje skyes pa'i dam tshig 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog ljang khu g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje bsgyings pa dang*/ g.yon dril bu/ zhu ba'i dril bur gyur/ sna tshogs can gyis 'gro skyabs phyir// sogs dang*/ dbang bskur sogs dang*/ oṃ dril bu rdo rje rab ldan pa/ shin tu dpa' bo nyid dbang bskur// rdo rje dam tshig gnas pa khyod// bdag po'i dbang bskur rgyal mnos shig /oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe aḥ.aḥbacom ldan gzung ngo bdag la ni// yang dag nye bar gyur par mdzod// ces brjod du gzhug chu dbang*/ rigs bdag gis dbu brgyan/ lha thams cad don grub kyi rnam pas/ dril bu'i dbang thob/ phrag dog gi dri ma dag 'du byed kyi phung po gnas gyur/ bya grub ye shes mngon du byas// don grub kyi sa bon/ de la brten pa'i sogs brjod/ de nas slob ma bsangs sbyangs// oṃ dang 'khor lo las skyes pa'i sku'i 'khor lo bde mchog dkar po g.yas 'khor lo/ g.yon dril bu bsgyings pa dang bcas pa dkur 'dzin/

rang 'dra'i shes rab mas 'khyud pa/ 'khor lo can gyis 'gro skyabs phyir// dang*/ dbang bskur sogs dang*/ oṃ shrī he ru ka a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ he ru ka nā ma a bhi ṣe ka taḥkye dpal che ge mo rdo rje zhes ming btags/ chus dbang bskur/ rigs bdag gis dbu brgyan/ dbang lha thams cad rnam snang gi rnam pas slob ma'i lus la thim/ lus ngag yid gsum rnam snang gi rang bzhin du gyur pa la mchod/ ming dbang thob/ gti mug sbyangs/ gzugs phung gnas gyur/ me long ye shes mngon du byas/ rnam snang gi bag chags bzhag de la brten pa'i dngos grub dang 'phrin las bsgrub pa la dbang ngo*// zhes dag pa sbyin/ rdo rje slob ma'i dbang bskur ro// de nas slob dpon gyi dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ kye ho snying rje'i gter bdag la// khyed kyi bka' drin gang gi bdag /bdag dang gzhan nus 'gyur ba yis// rdo rje slob dpon dbang bskur gsol// zhes gsol ba btab/ lho sgor rin po ches spras pa'i khri'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma'i shar 'dab la 'khor lo/ lhor rin chen/ nub tu pad+ma/ byang du ral gri bris pa'i dbus su phyag rgya lngas brgyan/ mchan khung du kha ṭ+wāṃ ga thogs pa'i slob ma bzhag steng du bla re dang*/ g.yas g.yon du gdugs rgyal mtshan/ mchod rdzas rnams bkod de/ slob ma bsangs sbyangs/ hūṃ dang rdo rje las gtso bor bskyed/ ye shes pa gzhug dbang bskur sogs sngar bzhin byas/ bde gshegs can gyis 'gro skyabs phyir/ sogs dang*/ dbang bskur/ sogs dang*/ chu dbang rigs bdag gis dbu brgyan/ dbang lha thams cad ye shes pa'i ngo bor thim par gyur te/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+re swā hā/ zhes me tog gtor la byin gyis brlab bo// de nas dam tshig gsum sbyin pa'i don du/ rdo rje bsangs sbyangs/ hūṃ dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i rdo rje sems dpar bskyed pa sogs byas la/

zhu ba las byung ba'i rdo rje/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni// zhes pa nas/ bdag po'i bdag/ zhes pa'i bar brjod/ bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu'o// oṃ ma hā badz+ra hūṃ/ zhes slob mas kyang rjes zlos byed do// dril bu bsangs sbyangs/ āḥlas rdo rje snyems mar bskyed/ zhu ba'i dril bu/ 'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyi// byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed// ces brjod/ lag pa g.yon du sbyin/ slob mas kyang*/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe aḥ.aḥ ces brjod/ yid kyi lus su brtan byed pa/ dam tshig phyag rgyar grags pa yis// skur ni nye bar gnas gyis la// phyag rgya rtag tu brtan par gyis// ye shes phyag rgyar byin brlabs ni// 'dod pa thams cad longs spyod de// dngos grub thams cad sgrub par gyis// zhes brjod la 'khyud tshul byed du gzhug go /de la nyer spyod kyis mchod// mi bskyod rdo rje zhes sogs kyis bstod la/ de nyid ston pa la/ dkyil 'khor gyi de nyid ni/ thams cad dngos po gcig nyid du// sprul sku'i mdzad pa rdzogs gyur pa// dur khrod yin te lus su dag /ye shes snang ba kun khyab cing*// bdud bcom 'od dang rdo rje can// mi mnyam med pas zur bzhi pa// 'phags pa'i bden pa dngos gzhi nyid// dran dang dbang po ngos bzhi ste// bsam gtan rnams kyi rta babs nyid// tshon sna lnga po sangs rgyas te// dge ba'i spyod pa shīr+ṣa ka /grwa tshogs byang chub yan lag bdun// ba dan dril bu gsung rab sgra// ting nge 'dzin gyi kha khyer te// gzungs ni 'dod pa'i lha mo'o// pad+ma 'dam gyis ma gos te/ rnam thar brgyad kyi ka ba nyid// sna tshogs chos 'khor rgyal po'i gnas// 'khor lo gdugs kyis rnam par mdzes// chos kyi dbyings su ro gcig phyir// rtse mo rdo rjes brgyan pa nyid// ces dang lha'i de nyid/ lus dran pa nye bar bzhag pa sogs dang*/

slob dpon gyis de nyid kyang brjod do/ /de nas slob ma'i mig tu praṃ las mi shes pa'i rab rib 'dus par bsams la// pra las skyes pa'i gser gyi thur ma mar dang sbrang rtsi 'dus pa'i mig sman la smyugs te// ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis// zhes nas/ pa tra laṃ hriḥ zhes brjod pas/ rab rib bsal/ ye shes kyi spyan dbye bar bsam/ de nas āḥlas skyes pa'i me long āḥyis bsdags la bstan te/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu nyid// ces pa nas/ 'on kyang sangs rgyas sras su skyed// zhes brjod la chos kyi mtshan nyid bstan no// āḥlas skyes pa'i dril bu āḥbazlas pas dkrol du gzhug thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid te// zhes sogs brjod la/ sgra thams cad nam mkha' ltar shes par gyis shig hoḥlas skyes pa'i mda' gzhu la hoḥbarjod de/ chos nyid gzhu yi ye shes mda'// phyogs mtshams steng 'og kun tu 'phongs// bdud sogs bcom pas de bzhin gshegs// thams cad rjes su mnyes par gyis// zhes pas phyogs bzhi steng 'og tu mda' 'phen pa'i tshul byed gzhug go/ de nas oṃ badz+ra he tu māṃ gyis 'khor lo rkang pa'i bar du bzhag oṃ badz+ra bhā ṣa raṃ gyis dung lag pa g.yas su sbyin/ dril bu dang po ti g.yon du gtad nas klog tu gzhug deng nas brtsams te sems bskyed pa// zhes nas/ khyod la rtag tu srung bar byed// ces dang*/ de ring rdo rje slob dpon 'gyur// sngags dang rgyud ni 'dzin gyur pas// sangs rgyas byang chub sems rnams dang*// lha rnams kyis kyang mthun par gsungs// sems can kun la rjes brtse bas// khyod kyis dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin// nan tan bskyed de bri bar bya// sgrub pa po rnams rgyud la sbyor// zhes brjod/ de nas rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan bsangs sbyangs rigs lngar bskyed/ zhu ba las byung ba'i phyag mtshan slob ma rnam snang du bskyed pa'i lag tu 'khor lo gtad//

sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir// 'jig rten khams ni thams cad du// ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul gyur pa'i// chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ slob ma mi bskyod par bskyed pa la rdo rje gtad/ chos kyi 'khor lo'i gnas su/ rdo rje'i 'khor lo dang*/ rin chen/ pad+ma las kyi 'khor lo sogs brjod la dkyil 'khor bri ba'i rjes gnang sbyin no// zhi rgyas dbang dang dgug pa dang*// sngang bar byed dang rengs sogs dang*// bsad dang bskrad pa thams cad dang*// las de rnams ni sgrub par gyis// zhes 'phrin las bsgrub pa'i rjes gnang dang*/ ral gri mig sman sa 'og dang*// rkang mgyogs bcud len mkha' la 'gro// mi snang la sogs grub pa'i tshogs// ci dga' bar ni sgrub par gyis// zhes dngos grub sgrub pa'i rjes gnang sbyin// de nas bla ma'i zhabs la phyag byas/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa// de ltar bdag ni bgyid par 'tshal// zhes khas blang ngo*// slob ma dang rdo rje bsangs sbyangs/ hūṃ las rdo rje sems dpar bskyed de zhu ba las byung ba'i rdo rje/ 'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu gzung*// phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭhaḥs+t+waṃ dhā ra yā mi hīḥhi hi hi hi hūṃ hūṃ/ zhes brjod la rdo rje gtad/ slob mas kyang sngags de brjod pa ni rdo rje'i brtul zhugs so// kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsangs sbyangs gtso bo yab yum du bskyed/ zhu ba'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga g.yon gyi gru khugs su sbyin/ lag pa g.yas su ḍā ma ru/ g.yon du thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba// phrag par tshangs skud byin la/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang ḍā ma ru/ zhes pa nas/ dpa' bo chen po blang bar gyis/ zhes dang*/ gtso bo'i snying po tshar gcig brjod nas bdud rtsi 'thung du gzhug de nas slob ma rnams lha mo brgyad kyi nga rgyal 'dzin bzhin pas phyag rgya re re nas 'ching du bcug ste/

deng nas brtsams te rdzogs sangs rgyas// zhes pa nas gzung*/ byang chub lus can rnams la bsgos// zhes pa'i bar brjod/ de rnams lha mchod pa'i rjes gnang ngo*// de nas slob dpon lag pa g.yon pas chos gos kyi grwa 'dzin pas dril bu 'chang*/ g.yas skyabs sbyin nam mchog sbyin gyis rdo rje bsdams nas/ oṃ 'dir ni khyod la ngas lung bstan// rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs// srid pa shin tu dag pa'i phyir// srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton// kye dpal che ge mo zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa sid+dh+ya sa ma yas+t+waṃ bhur+bhu baḥswaḥ zhes che ge'i gnas su gsang mtshan bcug pas lung bstan la/ gang la tshig 'dis lung bstan pa// de la sangs rgyas byang chub sems// 'khor dang bcas pa mgrin gcig tu// byang chub chen por lung bstan te// phyag rgya sngags 'di'i mthu yin zhes// slob ma dad pa rab tu bskyed// ces bsgo bar bya'o// de nas/ 'dod chags bral ba lta bu'i sdig /khams gsum na ni gzhan med de// de bas 'dod la chags bral bar// khyod kyi nam yang mi bya'o// ma hā sa ma ya hūṃ phaṭ/ ces gsang bar gdams/ gtso bo'i sngags tshar gcig brjod nas/ bcom ldan 'di la sbyin lags kyi// 'di la nye bar mdzad du gsol// zhes brjod/ slob mas/ bcom ldan gzung ngo bdag la ni// yang dag nye bar gyur par mdzod// ces me tog 'phreng ba rang gi mgo bor bzung la/ sngags tshar gcig bzlas pa ni sngags kyi rjes gnang ngo*// de nas slob mas gdugs bzung ste dkyil 'khor la bskor ba byed du bcug nas/ sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin gyur pa'i// slob ma 'di ni phul ba lags// zhes brjod cing*/ mchog gsang dkyil 'khor dam pa 'dir// zhugs pa dang ni mthong ba yis// sdig pa kun las rnam grol nas// de ring khyed rnams bde bar gnas// bde chen theg pa 'di la ni// phyin chad 'chi ba yong med de// mi thub tshugs pa yod min pas// cis kyang ma 'jigs dga' bar gyis// srid pa shin tu dag pa'i phyir// srid pa'i sdug bsngal las khyod 'das// gang zhig skyes pa tsam gyis ni// sangs rgyas nyid du dgos med pa'i// byang chub sems ni spang mi bya// dam pa smad par mi bya ste// nam yang dor bar mi bya'o// mi shes pa'am rmongs pa la// gsang ba de nyid bstan mi bya// rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang*// sangs rgyas kun dang mtshungs gyur pa'i// slob dpon smad par mi bya ste// rang bdag yongs su spangs pa yis// dka' thub kyis ni gdung mi bya// ji ltar bde bar bde gzung nas/

'di ni ma byon rdzogs sangs rgyas// zhes gzengs bstod dang*// dbugs dbyung byas la/ slob mas phyag bgyid bzhin pas/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa// de bzhin du ni bdag gis bgyid/ ces khas blang ngo*// de yang dkyil 'khor bzhi las phyi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du bum pa chu'i dbang thob/ spang bya lus kyi dri ma dag phung khams skye mched lha'i rnam par gyur// sprul sku'i nus pa bzhag bskyed rim bsgom pa dang*/ dngos grub bsgrub cing dam tshig bsrung ba la dbang*/ sku rdo rje mngon du 'gyur pa'i skal ldan du byas so//

de nas/ gsang dbang gi don du/ rig ma mtshan ldan dang maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ skyob pa skyabs med rnams kyi skyabs// 'khor lo sdom pas skyabs mdzod cig /rgyu med par ni thugs rje che// mgon med bdag gi mgon mdzod cig/ ces gsol ba lan gsum btab/ slob ma dang rig ma'i gdong ras kyis bcings/ yol ba'i nang du skad cig gis rang re he ru ka dang rig ma phag mor bskyed// sku gsung thugs byin rlabs dang go cha bskon/ rdo rje dang pad+ma byin gyis brlabs nas snyoms 'jug bya zhing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes 'don zhing*/ thugs kha'i sa bon las 'od 'phros// rigs lnga yab yum spyan drangs/ spyi bo nas zhugs/ chags pa'i mes byang chub kyi sems zhu/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje nor bur lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ba brtan par byas te/ mthe bong dang srin mdzub kyis btsir nas pad+ma nas phyung ba/ slob ma 'od dpag med du bskyed pa'i lce thog tu/ 'das pa'i rdo rje 'chang sogs kyis// ji ltar sangs rgyas dbang bskur// de bzhin du ni byang chub sems// mdzes pas bu khyod dbang bskur ro// oṃ hrīḥha ha hūm̐ hūṃ phaṭ ces brjod la sbyin/ des kyang*/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i blos// a ho ma hā su khaṃ/ zhes brjod la btung ngo*// rig mas kyang gcer bu pad+ma na gnas pa'i byang sems/ 'di de dpa' bo lha mo rnams// dam tshig rmad byung chen po ste// khams lnga ldan pa'i ro rtogs byed// bde ba de gang myang bar bya// zhes brjod la sbyin// des kyang 'thungs pas/ mgrin par rtsa stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis 'dus pa'i rtsa 'dab bcu drug byang chub sems kyis gang*/ de nas brgyud nas lus thams cad gang nas// gsal stong bde bas brgyan pa'i ting nge 'dzin skyes par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes pas mig dar dbye// de ltar dbang bzhi las bha ga'i dkyil 'khor mthong*/

gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag lam bdag byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ dam tshig sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga bsten pa la dbang*/ longs spyod rdzogs sku'i sa bon bzhag /gsung rdo rje mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal ldan du byas so// de las shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ byang chub rdo rjes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ slob ma dang rig ma mig dar bcings/ slob ma mi bskyod par bskyed/ go bgo ye shes pa gzhug sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs nas/ rig ma gzugs dang lang tshor ldan pa de'i lag tu gtad la/ sangs rgyas thams cad dpang por byas te/ rig ma'i spyi bor rdo rje bzhag nas/ lha mo 'di ni phyag rgya che// mtha' yas bde ba sbyin pa mo// rnam pa kun tu phyag rgya yang*// bu yis bla med mchod par gyis// zhes brjod de phyag rgya gtad pa'i dbang ngo*// de nas rig ma des skra bshig gos dang bral bar byas nas/ slob ma la/ bshang gci la sogs bza' ba dang*// khrag dang khu ba de bzhin sha// rtag par bud med mchog gus pas// bha ga'i pad+mar 'o byed pa// bu khyod spro bar byed dam ci// bu yis ji ltar bde bar smros// de'i lan du/ bshang gci la sogs bza' ba dang*// bud med la yang rtag gus bgyid/ bha ga nyid la 'o byed par// lha mo ci phyir bdag mi spro// zhes brjod pas lha mo de mnyes nas/ gcer bu pad+ma rgyas pa kha phye nas slob ma la bstan te/ e ma nga yi pad+ma 'di// bde ba kun dang yang dag ldan// ci ste cho ga bzhin brten na// de yi mdun na nga gnas te /sangs rgyas bsnyen pa la sogs pa// bya ba thams cad pad+mas byed// bde chen rgyal po rang nyid ni// 'di nyid du ni yang dag gnas// bhañdza mok+ṣa hoḥ zhes gsung bar bsams nas/ slob ma dang rig ma gtso bo yab yum du bskyed// phung khams skye mched byin gyis brlab// go bgo rdo rje dang pad+ma 'dus yum gyi g.yon gyi char song ba'i rtsa'i rtse mo hrīḥdamar po dang ldan la/

mdzub mo dang lce sita ces bya bas bskul nas/ oṃ shi shi shi ha ha ha swā hā// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod cing*/ rang dang bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer/ gshegs pa gshegs ma spyan drangs la bcug snyoms 'jug gi dga' bzhi nyams su myong ste/ gang la thog ma dbus mtha' med// bdag med gzhan yang med ba ste// srid med myang ngan 'das pa med// 'di ni mchog tu bde chen nyid// ces 'od gsal gyi bde ba myong nas/ yang hūm̐ zhes thabs kyis gyen du drangs pas/ gsang bar dga' ba/ snying gar mchog dga'/ dpral bar khyad dga' / gtsug tor du lhan cig skyes dga' brtan par bsams// mi nus pa la lces blang la btung ngo*// de nas shes rab ma mnyes te/ de'i mgo bor lag pa bzhag nas/ deng nas gzung ste bu khyod kyis// ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar// ji ltar sems can thams cad kyi// don ni bdag nyid kun gyis byos/ /zhes rjes su gnang ba sbyin nas mig dar phye/ kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor mthong*// dbang gsum pa thob/ yid kyi dri ma dag pho nya'i lam bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos sku thob pa'i skal ba bzhag thugs rdo rje mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal ldan du byas so// de nas dbang bzhi pa zhu ba'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ khyed kyi zhabs kyi bka' drin kyis// gtso bo'i dbang bskur rnam gsum thob// de ring rin chen bzhi pa yang*/ bdag la bka' drin rab tu gsol// zhes gsol ba lan gsum gdab la/ du ba las ni mer shes shing*// chu skyar las ni chur shes pa// byang chub sems dpa' blo ldan gyis// rigs ni mtshan ma dag las shes// zhes gsungs pas/ dga' ba snang ba ye shes te bum dbang*/ mchog dga' snang ba mched pa ste gsang dbang*// khyad dga' snang ba nyer thob ste shes rab ye shes/ lhan cig skyes dga' ni thams cad stong pa 'od gsal ba ste dbang bzhi pa/

de yang dri ma dang bcas pa ma yin zhing*/ de dper byas nas/ don gyi dbang bzhi pa ni/ saṃ pu ṭa las/ gang na'ang bsgom pa po med de// bsgom bya cung zad yod ma yin// bsgom pa nyid kyang yod min te// de ni de nyid bsgom par 'dod// ces gsungs pas/ lus mnyam par bzhag pa'i spyod lam dang ldan/ ngag rlung rgyu ba sor bzhag dbang po'i sgo nas gzugs la sogs pa yul rnams kyis drangs par gyur te/ ngo bo nyid kyis phyi rol gyi yul g.yo ba'i sems ni/ yul la g.yo ba bzlog pa'i phyir/ phyi yul gyi snang ba rnam rang yab yum la bsdu/ yum yab la/ yab snying ga'i hūṃ la/ hūṃ gi zhabs kyu ha la/ de mgo bo la/ de zla tshes la/ de thig le la/ thig le nā da la/ nā da yang je phra je phra la mi dmigs par gyur te/ dmigs pa dang bral ba'i sems/ ci la yang mi sems/ gang du yang mi rtog pa/ bsgom bya sgom byed bsgom pa dang bral ba'i ngang la yun ring du bzhag go /de ltar don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa tshig gi sgo nas thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag lam phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu bde ba chen po sku'i sa bon bzhag ye shes rdo rje mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal ldan du byas so// de nas bla ma la phyag byas/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du// khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags kyis// zhes brjod/ lhag chad bskang ba'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg 'grub na yang bya'o// dkyil 'khor la mchod cing tshogs la longs spyod mchod yon phul/ dge rtsa bsngo/ dkyil 'khor la lan gsum bskor ba byas// yi ge brgya ba brjod/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// ces sogs brjod la/ ye shes pa gshegs dkyil 'khor bsdu// rdul tshon don du gnyer ba yod na sbyin/ med na rgya mtsho la sogs pa chu bo'i dbus su dor ro// dbang gi gnas skabs su bdag 'jug gi tshe/ bla ma'i bya ba rnams dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang*/

slob ma'i bya ba rnams rang gis byed par bsgom mo// de ltar 'khor lo sdom pa lha lnga'i dbang bskur ba'i cho ga 'di yang*/ sgrub sde bla ma thos bsam gyi nor gyis phyug pa rgyal dbang lhun grub kyis nan tan gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ shākya'i dge slong mi pham pad+ma dkar po phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i sdes/ gtsang myang smad kyi sa'i cha/ g.ya' lung gi ri bo'i mgul du sbyar ba'o/// / mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che// rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po// rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum// rdo rje mkha' 'gro= rnam par snang mdzad rab tu dga'// rdo rje zhi ba dga' ba che// rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal mchog /sangs rgyas= rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab// rdo rje mkha' 'gro dri ma med// dngos nyid dag pa gos pa med// rin chen= rdo rje dpag med rgyal po byed// mi rtog nam mkha'i rdo rje 'dzin// 'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes// pad+ma= rdo rje dag pa gdon mi za// bsam pa thams cad rab rdzogs byed// sangs rgyas ngo bo nyid las byung*// sna tshogs mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod// ces pa kha 'phangs kyi skabs su dgos pa'o// maṅga laṃ/// /
